subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Should telemetry grouping represent each rotating OpenClaw conversation via `sessionId`, or intentionally expose a durable pseudonym derived from the routing `sessionKey` across resets?
rationale: This choice defines both user-visible grouping semantics and the persistence of a privacy-sensitive telemetry identifier; code review cannot infer the intended product boundary safely.

options.title: Group by rotating session ID
options.body: Hash the current `sessionId`, never fall back to `sessionKey`, and treat resets as new telemetry sessions.

options.title: Keep durable routing grouping
options.body: Explicitly approve cross-reset correlation from `sessionKey` and revise the config name, documentation, threat model, and tests to describe that durable behavior.

options.title: Pause identifier export
options.body: Do not add the option until maintainers define an approved pseudonymous-identifier and reset policy.

recommendation.title: Group by rotating session ID
recommendation.body: Hash the current `sessionId`, never fall back to `sessionKey`, and treat resets as new telemetry sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public configuration, session semantics, and the diagnostics privacy boundary.
